copy.headline: How you open possibilities and how you turn them into completion are two ends of the same operating style.
copy.body: Openness shapes how widely you expand a problem; conscientiousness shapes how much structure you use to narrow, sequence, and finish it. Together they influence the cost of switching from exploration to delivery.
copy.strength_sentence: When exploration and structure are paired deliberately, you can preserve novelty while still leaving a usable result.
copy.risk_sentence: Reading either trait alone can miss idea-rich work that resists closure, or steady execution that closes alternatives too early.
copy.context_boundary: This interaction is clearest in open-ended work, long projects, and repeated tradeoffs; it may matter less in short tasks with fixed steps.
copy.action_hook: Notice where balance is most often lost: expansion, selection, starting, or finishing.
